contradictions: Mansagari: Mars 'powerful, conjunct or aspected by the malefics ... there will be cancellation'; Bhagat item 12: Mars conjunct or aspected by Sun, Mercury, Saturn or Rahu cancels.
Vishnu Bhaskar: Jupiter conjunct or aspecting Mars cancels 'as per classics'; 'experience shows' Jupiter+Mars or 1/7 increases the dosha.
Vishnu Bhaskar: 'Kuja Dosha effect is over after 28 years ... not supported by classics'; Bhagat: marriage should not be performed before 27 to 32 years.
